sources.title: Nvidia says its new AI safety platform can contain rogue agents within ‘milliseconds’

cards.summary: In an announcement on Monday , Nvidia says its new Open Agent Safety Platform can quarantine agents that attempt to escape their boundaries within "milliseconds." The platform uses Nvidia's OpenShell open-source software, which runs on the company's Vera AI CPU . Users can choose the information an AI agent can access, and OpenShell checks these restrictions before and during a task, according to Nvidia .
cards.title: Nvidia says its new AI safety platform can contain rogue agents within ‘milliseconds’

sources.title: OpenAI agents tried to ‘bruteforce’ a UN website

cards.summary: | AFP via Getty Images Security researcher Rowan Howard-Jones says that OpenAI agents scanned the UN Conference on Trade and Development's (UNCTAD) statistics site over 16,000 times between April and June . While the incident doesn't quite rise to the level of the Hugging Face hack , or the recent attacks on US government sites , it's yet another concerning example of AI agents going outside the normal bounds to accomplish a task.
cards.title: OpenAI agents tried to ‘bruteforce’ a UN website
